messages.subject: NULL data in downloadHandler
parts:
Hi all,
I was wondering whether there is a save way to handle a NULL object in the downloadHandler function. For example in the downloadHandler function something along the lines as

if(is.null(data)){
 do not attempt to store something on the client computer
}

I tried to return NULL in the content function or that nothing is executed but still a download dialog comes up + an error.

Regards

Christoph

messages.subject: Re: NULL data in downloadHandler
parts: It's probably too late to try to cancel a download in the download handler. Could you instead use a conditionalPanel in the UI to hide the button when certain conditions are not met?
